known_differences.rationale: Zen dependency-result read facade; Epic behavior linked to export-filter/import-outcome rules, but SQL/read-facade consumer coverage is not in formal operation.
V5 compact SQL accelerator deliberately drops detailed reasons; source-shaped metadata remains authoritative. Consumer-contract inventory missing.
Inventory filename glob correction; no Epic file-format operation.
Deployment and revision alignment; not a file-format source obligation.
Numeric FPackageId backend lookup canonicalization.
V5 SQL provider-summary consistency downstream of source-selected providers; not covered by Epic lookup operation alone.

The corrected IoContainerHeader.cpp serializer is separately pinned as a source/reader prerequisite of B006 FilePackageStoreBackend::Mount/Update, with 25 source/caller assertions, 34 byte fixtures and earlier read-only retained v5 header evidence; not mounted sort behavior or future cooked v6 acceptance.
Evidenced mounted file-backend package entries, first wins by order/sequence.
Originally documented B005 downstream status-propagation gate rediscovered and fixed after unrelated work; record as reopened known work, not proof of audit completion.

B009 Epic MakeView treats bHasVersioningInfo uint32 as boolean. Source-backed correction and all nine pinned version/custom-version/metadata round-trip checks pass; the full operation remains partial pending authentic versioned differential.

B010 source-backed corrections remove the unsupported zero-content gate and accept eight safe scratch bytes. Ten pinned conditional-layout/metadata checks pass; full operation remains partial pending independently cooked versioned threshold fixtures.

B009/B010 Step 8 V5 consumer accepted inconsistent versioning and conditional header layout. Seven failures reproduced before correction; 12 checks and isolated real fixtures pass after. Original operations remain partial.

B005 selector ignored nested runtime backend evidence and rebuilder overwrote conflicting evidence. Shared arbitration now rejects contradictory snapshots; four original negative-before regressions pass after correction. Hybrid editor mount acceptance remains open.

Epic UE5.8.3 FZenPackageImportedPackageNamesContainer reader never requires ImportedPackageNamesDataReader to reach HeaderSize. UnrealDB imposed an additional rejection on unconsumed trailing bytes; two source-shaped fixtures failed before the a9b4b3cf correction and pass afterwards. B011 is accepted with pinned source, independent wire/IoStore and dependency consumer tests.

Epic UE5.8.3 GetPublicExportIndex searches main exports first, then optional WITH_EDITOR. UnrealDB classified a matching hash in both as ambiguous. Independent regression failed before 27788226 and passed after; main+optional archive store entries now use distinct provider IDs and missing optional chunk is rejected. B012 original metadata/consumer operation is verified by source and end-to-end drivers.

Epic FilePackageStore.cpp:788-808 uses FindOrAdd but allows a later mounted entry to fill redirect/localization name while its saved FName is NAME_None. UnrealDB made the first observed source ID unconditional, blocking valid lower-mount name/target. Two independent source-shaped cases failed before 7a8708fb and pass afterwards; first-wins valid names, physical entries and missing-name-unknown behavior are preserved. Original B006 has bounded operation-level acceptance.

A bare package_store_context_authoritative flag previously fell back to the consumer container header when either effective global redirect/localization table was absent, falsely promoting local redirects over other mounted backends. B008 negative-before source-derived fixture failed and now returns unresolved until both explicit global mapping arrays are provided; source priority and isolated SQL consumers pass.

A bare package_identity_context_authoritative flag previously represented an absent CoreRedirect/instancing/loose-localization rewrite result as a proven empty mapping. B008 negative-before regression failed; the resolver now distinguishes no result (unknown/unresolved) from explicitly supplied empty package_identity_rewrites (known no rewrite), retaining independent serialized/effective/load package IDs.

Epic FPublicExportKey::MakeKey rejects zero ExportHash and invalid FPackageId. UnrealDB had treated a zero import hash, zero imported package ID and zero selected-provider package ID as normal missing evidence. Three source-derived tests failed before 14f3c1e4 and now reject invalid source keys explicitly; all valid-key lookups and V5 consumers pass.

Epic's header GetPublicExportIndex scans main exports first, stops on the earliest matching index and tests optional only under WITH_EDITOR. But live FGlobalImportStore StorePublicExport may replace an object under the same hash. UnrealDB previously suppressed source-header first-candidate provenance when collision rows remained unresolved. First-candidate evidence is now recorded with runtime_lookup_authoritative=false; a negative-before regression and temporary real UEDB5 round-trip confirm that the live winner is never fabricated.
B016 optional cell-only header metadata falsely resolved without Epic live Verse registration. 4e4eaf9e before/after reproduced; operation oracle and V5 consumers pass.
B016 combined cell import/export offsets and first main-header candidate collision provenance were missing; three independent 4e4eaf9e regressions pass after correction.

Epic recursively considers imported FPackageIds even without public object imports. Prior UnrealDB persisted IDs but failed to emit standalone resolver requirements, omitting them from physical provider discovery/SQL. Historical f6d59d11 produced zero edges; 15208171 now writes main/optional V5 dependencies and isolated SQL 9/10, with live loader state conservatively unresolved.

Epic FCookedScriptObjectsDebug::LoadDebugData reads exactly NumObjects fixed-size entries from a contiguous view without requiring end-of-chunk; UnrealDB rejected trailing bytes. 2ab7af16 removes only the unsourced strict-EOF gate. Pinned Epic oracle and original 2b4377b0 before/after pass; complete B001 remains partial.

Epic debug ScriptObjects uses FMappedName::GetIndex() without checking EType; Global mapped type=2 in every one of 54968 authentic Satisfactory cooked entries. UnrealDB previously demanded type=1, so the real chunk failed. 471b6d14 permits mapped types 0/1/2 using valid bounded index; original a3d159a3 rejected type 2; source+real fixture prove corrected behavior.

Epic debug Objects.Emplace(GlobalIndex) routes through TMap::Emplace and TSet::TryReplaceExisting, replacing prior values on duplicate keys. UnrealDB rejected duplicates as malformed. 471b6d14 implements last-entry-wins with independent Epic helper oracles and original-vs-fixed duplicate regression; retained real chunk happens to have no duplicates.

Epic UE5.8.3 FPackageObjectIndex::FromScriptPath generates a 62-bit script hash used by live ScriptObjects.FindRef. UnrealDB V5 dependency_results retained ScriptImport required_object_identity, but Uedb5DependencyProjectionBuilder stripped it from SQL dependency_edges (NULL kind and key). Fixed a1338232cf078677a8d62814009e100f1b9e3f00 by new distinct OBJECT_KEY_SCRIPT_IMPORT_HASH=3 and exact 8-byte binary identity without inventing package/provider/live registration. Historical baseline dropped the key; fixed source+authentic Satisfactory hash, SQLite publisher and session-temporary real MySQL tests passed. Subsequent authentic UE5.8.3 editor traces verified initial/editor/nested-public registrations, live find, real GC removal and post-GC null lookups. Independent SCRIPT-003 and SCRIPT-004 operation-level drivers passed, and both original operations have been formally verified; unrelated Verse VNI and ScriptCells branches remain with B015-1.

Epic UE5.8.3 AsyncLoading2.cpp GetImportName returns live UObject name when FindRef succeeds, otherwise optionally cooked diagnostic GetPathName. The cooked debug map is trimmed against live ScriptObjects while retaining outer ancestors of missing entries, rendering paths with dot/colon/question separators. UnrealDB cooked reader retained names/outer indices but lacked a diagnostic-only path or trim preview. f3c960bb adds source-shaped explicit offline preview, tested against 54,968 authentic Satisfactory entries and synthetic trim/outer/cycle cases. Subsequent direct UE5.8.3 editor runtime verified live-first lookup and real GC; a freshly cooked real global.utoc ScriptObjects chunk decoded 23,672 entries and loaded all 23,672 into the real cooked PreCDO registry. The original compiled FPackageImportStore::GetImportName was explicitly invoked under CDB for cooked typed ScriptImport 5635D6648A5A6CB7 absent from the live registry: actual FCookedScriptObjectsDebug::GetPathName fired and returned /Script/ActionableMessage.ActionableMessageSubsystem, exactly matching corrected UnrealDB's opt-in offline preview. This was a controlled debugger fixture, not a naturally scheduled gameplay import. Original SCRIPT-005 now passes the composite 14-check operation driver plus 59 prerequisite source/boundary/runtime assertions. Distinct B015-1 Verse VNI/ScriptCells remains partial.

Epic UE5.8.3 AsyncLoading2.cpp hashes script paths with ASCII-only TChar::ToLower, dot/colon slash normalization, UTF16LE TCHAR CityHash64, and 62-bit mask; Verse paths hash unchanged UTF8. UnrealDB previously consumed serialized script_import_hash but lacked a callable independent source-equivalent path generator/native arithmetic oracle. Added pure PHP CityHash64 and typed path hasher; original Epic CityHash.cpp compiled as disposable native test oracle; 98 Unicode/ASCII/length vectors in both modes, real Satisfactory GetRecipes and ObjectRedirector hashes, and 13 independent acceptance assertions pass. No serialized package hashes are silently recalculated; no live script registry claim.

Epic treats ExportBundleData index1 as optional segment of main index0; UnrealDB name, publish and viewer paths could promote it to a separate Zen file with mismatched main V5. c555f1c4 confines standalone identities to chunk0, preserves raw optional TOC/parent metadata, proves historical negatives and 27 corrected checks; no independently cooked optional sample.

Count-only IoStore index retries accepted changed package IDs, chunk indexes and lengths. 1bb60bd9 rechecks every stored identity and container header under transactional row locking against retained TOC. 21 independent tests use 27240 real Satisfactory TOC entries in isolated SQLite. Actual MySQL concurrency not established.

Classic UE5 package admission had an UnrealDB-only UE5 component minimum of 1000. Epic's classic loader does not impose that standalone minimum. 1988f933 removed only the artificial lower bound while retaining source-backed serialized layout/version gates. The correction is regression-tested, but the classic source denominator and an independent alternate-layout differential are not yet complete.

Final Zen V5 dependency validation omitted imported_package_ids and interpreted a nonexistent target_type instead of serialized export-bundle kind. cbad1016 corrected the validator and the retained genuine Satisfactory snapshot now validates all 98 dependency results. Complete independent Zen metadata semantics remains a separate certification gate.

UnrealDB parsed real PAK v11 compact full-directory indexes as the legacy flat layout. 21790ec0 added the Epic UE5.8.3 compact directory/encoded-entry path. Epic UnrealPak independently matched 4761 entries and decoded size/hash evidence for the supported v11 full-directory subset. Optional modern PAK layouts explicitly remain unsupported and outside the present support claim.

Uedb5IoStoreTocReader rejected trailing bytes after the known TOC metadata table, but Epic FIoStoreTocResourceView::Read followed by FIoStoreTocResourceStorage::FinalizeRead imposes no EOF condition. The new source-derived extension fixture failed alone before the correction and the foundation suite passes 34/34 after removing only that extra gate. Complete IoStore semantic coverage remains open.
